The [[Aiel]] term for being in a state of war with another Aiel clan or sept. They arise from matters of [[ji'e'toh]], as opposed to the more typical conflict over water and other resources.

At the time of the Aiel conquest of the [[Stone of Tear]], there were three ongoing blood feuds.{{ref/book|4|22}} At the [[Field of Merrilor]], [[Rhuarc]] stated he had "buried blood feuds" for [[Rand al'Thor]], perhaps indicating that [[Taardad]] had multiple ongoing blood feuds.{{ref/book|14|6}}

All blood feuds (except perhaps any involving the [[Shaido]]) were held in abeyance when the Aiel united under Rand as the [[Car'a'carn]], and this abeyance likely survived the [[Last Battle]] and lasted for decades or more.{{ref/book|13|49}}

== Known blood feuds ==

# [[Shaarad]] and [[Goshien]] feuded for over 400 years.{{ref/book|3|38}}{{ref/book|4|18}} [[Janduin]] nearly ended the feud, but [[Laman]]'s cutting of [[Avendoraldera]] interrupted his progress.{{ref/book|4|34}} [[Bael]] and [[Jheran]] ended the feud while following [[Rand al'Thor]] from [[Rhuidean]] to [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]].{{ref/book|5|30}}
# [[Taardad]] and [[Nakai]] feuded for 200 years until it was ended by Janduin.{{ref/book|4|34}}
